faq.title: Everything you need to know before starting.
faq.subtitle: Didn't find your question? Reach us on WhatsApp. We reply during business hours.

items.q: How long does it take to build my site?
items.a: It depends on scope. A landing page ships in about 5 to 10 business days. A company site takes 2 to 4 weeks. Sites with booking or custom features take 4 to 6 weeks. You get a clear timeline right after the briefing.

items.q: Do I need a domain and hosting already?
items.a: No. We handle everything: domain registration, hosting, SSL certificate and professional emails. If you already have them, we integrate with your current provider.
We take 50% at project start and 50% on delivery. Monthly maintenance plans are billed on a recurring basis.

items.q: Do you deliver the source code?
items.a: Yes. The code is yours. We hand over full access to the repository, hosting and domain.

items.q: Will the site be fast and SEO-ready?
items.a: Yes. Every project follows performance best practices (Core Web Vitals) and technical SEO. We target Lighthouse above 95.

items.q: Can I edit text and images by myself later?
items.a: Yes, when it makes sense. We can integrate a simple panel for content edits. For bigger changes, maintenance plans cover ongoing work.

items.q: Do you work with clients outside Belgium?
items.a: Yes. We work remotely with clients across Europe and Portuguese-speaking countries.

items.q: What if I need something not listed here?
items.a: Every project can be customised. Describe your need in the form and we'll send a tailored quote.
